title: Editors cannot add References on a tenant-configured site: intake refuses every request
description: On Machines on Machines, papyrus references create-from-catalog --status pending, signed in as an editor, fails with: Shared-tenant Reference intake is not supported. The check in src/papyrus_content/reference_intake_validation.py refuses whenever the backend has PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID set. --dry-run passes and does not reveal this, because it skips server authorization. Found 2026-11-03 importing 23 sources for a Story. The refusal's only documented alternative is the IAM lane, which conflicts with signed-in CLI operation. Decide: this site has its own backend and one publication, so can the guard be narrowed to a backend that really is shared, or does knowledge data need the reviewed tenancy design the intake doc asks for? Related: PPY-98224e (references add).
